title: Buccaneers linebacker Alex Anzalone named NFC Defensive Player of the Week

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Buccaneers linebacker Alex Anzalone named NFC Defensive Player of the Week
sources.description: Tampa Bay Buccaneers linebacker Alex Anzalone has been named the NFC Defensive Player of the Week following his standout performance in the team’s 16-0 shutout victory over the Atlanta Falcons in Week 8. The veteran linebacker played a key role in Tampa Bay’s defensive dominance on Sunday, intercepting Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. twice in […]
